## Software proof points

- GymEasy (founder, back-end lead): SaaS gym-management platform in paid beta;
  QR attendance, digital POS, coach-client pipelines; 67% front-desk staff
  reduction. Stack: Next.js, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS.
- AgriPinoy: capstone agri-tech platform, national competition finalist.
- StaySafe: Flutter safety app with live GPS tracking and SOS.
- JCSD: construction procurement system (ordering, bidding, suppliers).
- B.S. Computer Science, Ateneo de Davao University (2021–2026), Dean's List.
- Engineering stack: Flutter, Dart, Next.js, TypeScript, Spring Boot, Python,
  Supabase, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Docker, AWS.
